## Introduction

This presentation shows an overview of crime (offences) in the world in 2025.

Data is illustrative for learning purposes.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## What are offences?

Offences include: - Theft - Assault - Fraud - Cybercrime

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Example data (2025)

```{r}
# Create sample dataset
offences <- data.frame(
  region = c("Europe", "Asia", "North America", "South America", "Africa"),
  cases = c(3200000, 5100000, 2800000, 2300000, 4100000)
)

offences
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Bar chart of offences

```{r}
# Simple bar plot
barplot(
  offences$cases,
  names.arg = offences$region,
  main = "Number of offences by region (2025)",
  ylab = "Number of cases",
  las = 2
)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Observations

-   Asia shows the highest number of recorded offences\
-   Africa and Europe also have high numbers\
-   South America has the lowest in this dataset

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Types of offences (example)

```{r}
types <- data.frame(
  type = c("Theft", "Assault", "Fraud", "Cybercrime"),
  cases = c(7000000, 5000000, 3000000, 2000000)
)

barplot(
  types$cases,
  names.arg = types$type,
  main = "Types of offences worldwide (2025)",
  col = "lightblue"
)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Conclusion

-   Crime levels vary by region\
-   Economic and social factors influence offence rates\
-   Cybercrime is growing rapidly worldwide

------------------------------------------------------------------------
